<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>getImpact</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">@NonNull
<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-trafficincidentimpact" title="enum in com.here.sdk.traffic">TrafficIncidentImpact</a>&nbsp;getImpact()</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Gets the impact of the incident.
 <p>The value is <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-trafficincidentimpact#UNKNOWN"><code>TrafficIncidentImpact.UNKNOWN</code></a> if it hasn't been provided by the traffic incidents supplier.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="returnLabel">Returns:</span></dt>

</dl>

</ul>
<a id="getType()">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>getType</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">@NonNull
<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-trafficincidenttype" title="enum in com.here.sdk.traffic">TrafficIncidentType</a>&nbsp;getType()</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Gets the category of the incident.
 <p>The value is <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-trafficincidenttype#UNKNOWN"><code>TrafficIncidentType.UNKNOWN</code></a> if it hasn't been provided by the traffic incidents supplier.</div>

<dt><span class="returnLabel">Returns:</span></dt>

<a id="getDescription()">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>getDescription</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">@NonNull
<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-localizedtext" title="class in com.here.sdk.core">LocalizedText</a>&nbsp;getDescription()</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Gets the human readable description of the incident, possibly with location information.
 <p>The description is currently not present in our map data. Therefore, when
 accessing the data from a picked carto POI via <code>TrafficIncidentResult</code>, then
 always an empty string is returned. This does not apply when using the <code>TrafficEngine</code>.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="returnLabel">Returns:</span></dt>
<dd><p>The human readable description of the incident, possibly with location information.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="getStartTime()">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>getStartTime</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">@Nullable
java.util.Date&nbsp;getStartTime()</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Gets the time from which the incident is valid, before this time the incident should not be considered.
 <p>The value is <code>null</code> if it hasn't been provided by the traffic incidents supplier.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="returnLabel">Returns:</span></dt>
<dd><p>The time from which the incident is valid, before this time the incident should not be considered.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>

<li class="blockList">

<pre class="methodSignature">@Nullable
java.util.Date&nbsp;getEndTime()</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Get the time until which the incident is valid, after this time the incident should not be considered.
 <p>The value is <code>null</code> if it hasn't been provided by the traffic incidents supplier.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="returnLabel">Returns:</span></dt>
<dd><p>The time until which the incident is valid, after this time the incident should not be considered.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
